quests.title: Seeds for Old Tom's House
quests.giver: a resident of Mrs Quayle's House
quests.summary: A resident of Mrs Quayle's House has saved seed for a gardener in Old Tom's House. Take it over and bring back the news.

steps.text: Deliver the seed to Old Tom's House.
steps.line: Ah, her beans! I've been waiting all winter. Tell her I've a bed ready and a very smug cat.

steps.text: Take the thanks back to Mrs Quayle's House.
steps.line: Pleased as punch, was she? Good. Now I'll not have to carry them myself next year.

start.ask: Moghrey mie, I've saved a twist of seed for a fellow gardener in Old Tom's House. It's no weight at all. Would you carry it?
start.accept: Keep it dry. They're the best beans in the county, and I'll hear nothing against them.
